## Issue tracking

For PRs from open-source community contributors:

- **New features**: a linked issue is **required**. Please open a [feature request](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) and reference it here before submitting the PR.
- **Small updates (bug fixes, minor improvements)**: a linked issue is **recommended** and will accelerate the PR review process.

Linked issue: <!-- e.g. Fixes #1234 / Related to #1234 -->

## Code provenance

You should always make a best effort to avoid copying code from other
 repositories. In exceptional cases in which this is unavoidable and you copied
 or adapted code from an external source, provide the following details and
 copy to the file header:

- Source URL, revision, and original file(s):
- Files in this PR containing the copied or adapted code:
- Applicable license(s):
- Required copyright notices and attribution, and where they are retained or added:

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [ ] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

Feel free to message or comment `@NVIDIA/mcore-oncall` to help accelerate your merge into main. The less complex your PR is, the faster it will be approved and merged!

All PRs start as **draft**. If you open a non-draft PR, it will be automatically converted to draft.

#### Step 1: Mark PR as "Ready for Review"

1. When your PR is ready, click **Ready for Review**.
2. An oncall reviewer is auto-assigned and expert reviewers are notified based on your changes.
   - Some PRs may jump straight to step 2. This is determined by `.github/CODEOWNERS`.

:warning: Only mark as ready once merge-conflicts are resolved and the CI is passing.
Final Review might get declined if these requirements are not fulfilled.

#### Step 2: Final Review

For PRs that change `megatron/core`, once all expert reviewers have approved, the `Final Review` label is applied **automatically** and final reviewers are assigned.

For PRs outside `megatron/core`, this step is skipped.

#### Step 3: Approved

Once all required reviewers have approved, the `Approved` label is applied **automatically**.

### Merge

Any member of [mcore-engineers](https://github.com/orgs/NVIDIA/teams/mcore-engineers) will be able to merge your PR.

This pull request requires additional validation before any workflows can run on NVIDIA's runners.

Pull request vetters can view their responsibilities [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/vetters).

Contributors can view more details about this message [here](https://docs.gha-runners.nvidia.com/cpr/contributors).

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=low -->

I found a regression-test gap and a style-guide violation. I didn't find a production logic error in the changed paths. I inspected all five changed files and their directly affected checkpoint and recompute contracts. Tests weren't run.

### Add an EGTP-remat regression case

The [new grouped-activation test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_moe_experts.py#L182-L207) leaves `expert_gtp_remat_size=1`. In that configuration, `expt_dp` and `expt_dp_gtp_remat` [are aliases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/megatron/core/parallel_state.py#L1697-L1717). Selecting `self.dp_group` instead of `self.dp_group_gtp_remat` would therefore still pass, leaving the rematerialization-specific part of this fix unprotected. With EGTP-remat size 2, that selection gives rematerialization peers duplicate main-replica IDs, which [checkpoint integrity validation rejects](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/megatron/core/dist_checkpointing/validation.py#L458-L474). The invariant is one owner for the shared activation object across ETP, EP, expert-DP, and EGTP-remat.

Extend this test to remat sizes 1 and 2. Preserve its existing replica-ID assertion and full-model save for size 1. For size 2, save only the activation entries: the current [test helper's process-group builder](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_utils.py#L1763-L1783) doesn't populate `expt_gtp_remat`, so simply parameterizing the full-model save would also exercise unrelated, unsharded linear-weight setup.

Proposed patch for [the grouped-activation test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_moe_experts.py#L177-L207), to verify before adopting:

```diff
@@
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("expert_gtp_remat_size", [1, 2])
     @pytest.mark.internal
     @pytest.mark.skipif(
@@
-    def test_grouped_te_activation_extra_state_tracks_expert_dp_replica(self, tmp_path_dist_ckpt):
+    def test_grouped_te_activation_extra_state_tracks_expert_dp_replica(
+        self, tmp_path_dist_ckpt, expert_gtp_remat_size
+    ):
@@
         Utils.initialize_model_parallel(
-            2, 1, expert_model_parallel_size=2, expert_tensor_parallel_size=1, order="tp-ep-dp-pp"
+            2,
+            1,
+            expert_model_parallel_size=2,
+            expert_tensor_parallel_size=1,
+            expert_gtp_remat_size=expert_gtp_remat_size,
+            order="tp-ep-dp-pp",
         )
@@
-            save(sharded_state_dict, ckpt_dir, validate_access_integrity=True)
+            state_to_save = (
+                sharded_state_dict if expert_gtp_remat_size == 1 else activation_extra_states
+            )
+            save(state_to_save, ckpt_dir, validate_access_integrity=True)
```

Acceptance checks, proposed rather than executed: on eight ranks, both cases must satisfy the existing replica-ID tuple assertion on every rank and save successfully with integrity validation. The remat-size-2 case must produce eight distinct activation replica IDs with exactly one main replica. Changing the activation DP coordinate to `self.dp_group` must fail that case while the existing remat-size-1 full-model save remains valid.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

<!-- nemo-ci-review-rendering:inline-v1 -->
<!-- nemo-ci-formal-review:48b2e29a4ecf9d53aa507d02682cd877b5592f5564a502de2d318d25111a381e:4ab1a55d06fce5cfe9447076bbe0514b250dd21e25b07851734ceae988fdd2f1 -->

Use double quotes for the added string literals. The [style guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/362cff32df01197938d1c7473f1787ded591b6fa/style-guide.md#L9-L10) explicitly requires them because Black preserves quote style.

```suggestion
        activation_metadata["dp_cp_group"] = self.dp_group_gtp_remat
```

Also use `name == "activation_func"` below, `key.endswith("activation_func._extra_state")` in both new checkpoint tests, `expert_type="te_grouped"` in the [expert test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_moe_experts.py#L187-L207), and double quotes around the new checkpoint-directory names there and in the [dense test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_mlp_glu.py#L107-L123).

Keep every string's contents unchanged; checkpoint keys, directory names, and branch behavior must remain identical. Static acceptance: the added literals use double quotes without changing their values. This doesn't require normalizing older, untouched literals.

+            ):

+                seen["input_ids"] = input_ids

+
+        hidden_states = torch.randn(4, 2, layer.config.hidden_size)
+        padding_mask = torch.ones(2, 4, dtype=torch.bool)
+        input_ids = torch.arange(8, dtype=torch.long).view(2, 4)
+        packed_seq_params = PackedSeqParams(qkv_format="thd")
+        output_with_bias, residual = layer._forward_mlp_output_with_bias(
+            hidden_states,
+            padding_mask=padding_mask,
+            packed_seq_params=packed_seq_params,
+            input_ids=input_ids,
+        )
+
+        # Only the checkpointed activation is positional; nothing else may leak into args.
+        assert len(seen["checkpoint_args"]) == 1
+        assert seen["checkpoint_args"][0] is hidden_states
+        assert set(seen["checkpoint_kwargs"]) == {"padding_mask", "input_ids", "packed_seq_params"}
+        assert seen["padding_mask"] is padding_mask
+        assert seen["input_ids"] is input_ids
+        assert seen["packed_seq_params"] is packed_seq_params
+        assert torch.equal(output_with_bias[0], hidden_states + 1)
+        assert output_with_bias[1] is None
+        assert residual is hidden_states
+
     def test_offload_scope_in_cuda_graph_preserves_gpt_rules(self):
         """The shared helper keeps the existing GPT attention/dense-MLP scope rules."""
         layer = self.parallel_transformer_layer

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=low -->

I found a regression-test gap and a style-guide violation. I didn't find a production logic error in the changed paths. I inspected all five changed files and their directly affected checkpoint and recompute contracts. Tests weren't run.

### Add an EGTP-remat regression case

The [new grouped-activation test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_moe_experts.py#L182-L207) leaves `expert_gtp_remat_size=1`. In that configuration, `expt_dp` and `expt_dp_gtp_remat` [are aliases](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/megatron/core/parallel_state.py#L1697-L1717). Selecting `self.dp_group` instead of `self.dp_group_gtp_remat` would therefore still pass, leaving the rematerialization-specific part of this fix unprotected. With EGTP-remat size 2, that selection gives rematerialization peers duplicate main-replica IDs, which [checkpoint integrity validation rejects](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/megatron/core/dist_checkpointing/validation.py#L458-L474). The invariant is one owner for the shared activation object across ETP, EP, expert-DP, and EGTP-remat.

Extend this test to remat sizes 1 and 2. Preserve its existing replica-ID assertion and full-model save for size 1. For size 2, save only the activation entries: the current [test helper's process-group builder](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/megatron/core/transformer/moe/moe_utils.py#L1763-L1783) doesn't populate `expt_gtp_remat`, so simply parameterizing the full-model save would also exercise unrelated, unsharded linear-weight setup.

Proposed patch for [the grouped-activation test](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/a074351af0b28de6143bf4eb9e542336bb8897c0/tests/unit_tests/dist_checkpointing/models/test_moe_experts.py#L177-L207), to verify before adopting:

Acceptance checks, proposed rather than executed: on eight ranks, both cases must satisfy the existing replica-ID tuple assertion on every rank and save successfully with integrity validation. The remat-size-2 case must produce eight distinct activation replica IDs with exactly one main replica. Changing the activation DP coordinate to `self.dp_group` must fail that case while the existing remat-size-1 full-model save remains valid.
